dex.entry: A drowsy round moon-sheep that drifts half-awake through the Nightreach highlands, trailing softly glowing wool-tufts that carry faint dream-motes wherever they float. The sleepiest, softest sheep in the world — just looking at it makes you yawn.

art.silhouette: Plump round sheep body in pale cream-blue, half-closed crescent eyes, small crescent-moon horns, fluffy wool with faint silver-blue glow-wisps drifting off it; maximally round silhouette at 32px.
